blocks.text: Custom exceptions allow you to define your own error types that can be raised and handled specifically.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: check_value(-1) is printed at the margin under try :, which is an IndentationError. It must be indented inside the try block; the program then prints Error : Value must be non-negative ! .

items: The check_value () function raises CustomError if the value is negative.
